sloka: हृतेति योऽधिगत्वा मां राघवाय निवेदयेत् ।गृध्रराजोऽपि स रणे रावणेन निपातितः ।। ५.२४.१९।।।।
transliteration: hṛteti yo'dhigatvā māṁ rāghavāya nivedayet ।gṛdhrarājo'pi sa raṇe rāvaṇena nipātitaḥ ।। 5.24.19।।।।

translations.english: The ogresses started intimidating Sita who was dressed in soiled clothes and emaciated with a dejected look on her face.
